name: qfd_vm_xplane_t
slot_change_request: el1011-qwen-tp8.log 2026-10-13 ~04:20 VM SLOT CHANGE REQUEST (bit-plane VM: 4 x 2 regions 1166.4 x 1080 + 187.92 um band, per-leaf clock roots) + PHYS follow-up of 10-13

job.purpose: Qwen TP8 VM bit-plane leaf: pin flop + rot1 + rot2 + bv for one bit position of 1,024 elements (4,173 flops incl. 33 me replicas, one root). 32 per die in the x-plane band. Bench = leaf miter vs the parent's expressions (NRB 16 shape) + 3 plane mutants.

benches.name: lf_ok
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O1 --output-split 20000 --output-split-cfuncs 2000 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -CFLAGS -O0 -j 2 --top-module tb_qfd_vm_xplane -GNRB=16 -GELEMS=16384  --Mdir {RUN}/bench/lf_ok rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/tb_qfd_vm_xplane.sv rtl/qwen_sys/vm_plane_20261013/ot_qfd_vm_xplane.sv > {RUN}/bench/lf_ok.build.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/lf_ok/Vtb_qfd_vm_xplane > {RUN}/bench/lf_ok.log 2>&1; cat {RUN}/bench/lf_ok.log | tail -3; grep -q '^PASS qfd_vm_xplane' {RUN}/bench/lf_ok.log
